attributes.title: Pacific Northwest Dental Conference 2027
attributes.summary:
PNDC 2027 is scheduled for April 1 to 3, 2027, at the Summit building of the Seattle Convention Center. WSDA says attendees can earn more than 20 dental CE credits in three days, and all lectures are included in registration; hands-on workshops cost extra.

Registration is open. WSDA member dentists pay $430 through the February 12, 2027, early-bird deadline and $530 after; recent graduate members pay $280 or $380, and WSDA ADA Life Members attend free. Washington State non-member dentists pay $2,178 early and $2,278 after. Team pricing is listed on the registration site. Future dates are already set for April 20 to 22, 2028.
